units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:10">Esth. R. to I, 2</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Chronicles 9:17">II Chr. IX, 17</cite>) [read:] <he>שהיה עשוי כמֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ של מי וכ׳</he> it was made like the chariot of him who spoke and the world existed.
Num. R. s. 12 אגרת … ומֶרְכַּבְתָּהּ Igrath … and her chariot; a. e.—Esp. the divine chariot of the vision of Ezekiel (Ez. I); מעשה מ׳, or מ׳ the mystic speculations on the divine chariot, esoterics.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82:6">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> <he>האבות הן הן המ׳</he> the patriarchs are the divine chariot.
<cite ref="Chagigah 13a:8">Ib. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>אגמרך במעשה המ׳</he> I shall instruct thee in the secret of the vision of Ezekiel.

<cite ref="Chagigah 13a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>עד היכן מעשה המ׳</he> up to which verse (in <cite ref="Ezekiel 1">Ez. I</cite>) do the speculations on ‘the Chariot’ go (the communication of which is subject to certain restrictions)?—Tosef. Meg. IV (III), 28.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:6">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> (ref. to <he>חדריו</he> <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:6">ib.</cite>) <he>מנין … ויגלה להם חדרי מ׳</he> how should Ezekiel be able to reveal to them the inwardness of the Chariot? Ib. 10 <he>שמא בחדרי מ׳ וכ׳</he> hast thou perhaps been studying the secrets of the Chariot?; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:4">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> <he>בסדרי מ׳</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. <he>מֶרְכָּבוֹת</he>. Pesik. Baḥod., p. 107ᵇ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite>; a. fr.
